senses.gloss: (deriv. of דִּבָּה or דְּבָב) to speak evil, be hostile, only in part. pass. דָּבוּב, f. דְּבוּבָה.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:3:2">Y. Erub. VII, 24ᶜ</cite> bot. a woman <he>שהיתה ד׳ לחבירתה</he> who was on bad terms with her neighbor (ib. III, 20ᵈ bot. <he>דבי׳</he>, corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>דְּבוּבִין</he>, <he>דְּבוּבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:11:1">Cant. R. to III, 11</cite> two legions <he>ד׳ זה עם זה</he> hostile to each other.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:11:1">Ib.</cite> fire and hail <he>ד׳ זה וכ׳</he> are hostile elements; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 4ᵃ <he>רכו׳</he> (corr. acc.).
